subject: Uptake runway slice & expansion approach
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@skylarkhealth.com>, Skylark Health Procurement <procurement@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Uptake runway slice & expansion approach

Priya / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow-up with the proposal we discussed and a pragmatic rollout to increase capacity without disrupting production SLAs. Attached: usage-report-June-2027.csv (token spend & percentiles) and a short SLA addendum draft.

TL;DR proposal:
- Contract: extend current term by 12 months, move 20% of reserved capacity to an "uptake runway slice" (short-term burst pool) for Q3 to cover expected feature launch.
- Economics: effective blended unit price unchanged for reserved tokens; burst pool billed at hourly blocks with a 10% uplift.
- Guardrails: canary rollout (2% traffic -> 10% -> 25%), automatic rollback triggers on latency or error-rate thresholds; automatic fallback to smaller model variant to preserve latency SLOs.

Ask:
1) Confirm procurement timeline for PO/Amendment (target: week of Jul 12).
2) Share any internal ROI/finance contact if you want a one-pager for approvals.
3) Approve the SLA carve (attached) so Legal can prepare the amendment.

If useful, Ben and Jordan are copied and can join a quick call to walk the usage report. Available 10–12 PDT tomorrow.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0168

Attachments: usage-report-June-2027.csv (CSV, 42 KB); SLA-addendum-v2.pdf (PDF, 94 KB)

From: Priya Shah <priya@skylarkhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Skylark Health Procurement <procurement@skylarkhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:14 -0400
Subject: Re: Uptake runway slice & expansion approach

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clear plan. A couple of clarifying questions after a quick look at the June spend:
- Can you provide expected on-demand spend delta if we keep burst at the 20% level for three months? High/median/low scenarios would help our finance folks.
- The canary rollback thresholds — can you list the exact numbers you propose for latency and error %? Procurement will want to confirm SLAs are not materially loosened.

Procurement note: procurement timeline likely two-week review cycle + legal redlines. If we can get an amendable DocuSign by Jul 8, purchasing can aim for a Jul 15 PO.

I'll loop in Anne from Finance if we need more detailed ROI inputs.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of AI Product | Skylark Health
priya@skylarkhealth.com

Subject: Re: Uptake runway slice & expansion approach

Priya —

Great questions. See inline answers and a short table below. I also attached a one-page ROI snapshot (embedded in the CSV) — let me know if you want that separated into a formal slide.

Scenario estimates (monthly incremental cost vs baseline):
- Low (feature adoption slower): +$6,200/mo (95th pct token usage stays low)
- Median (expected adoption curve): +$18,400/mo (expected usage ramp to 18% of traffic over 6 weeks)
- High (faster-than-expected adoption): +$44,000/mo (surge collisions mitigated by auto-burst)

Canary rollback thresholds (recommended):
- 99th-pct latency: > 450 ms sustained over 5 minutes -> automatic rollback to previous rollout percentage.
- Token-level error rate: > 0.8% over 10 minutes -> rollback and model-variant fallback.

Notes on SLA: these thresholds preserve our 99th latency SLO for production routes; SLA addendum limits customer financial exposure to proportional credits only if SLA breached after rollback fails.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm internal PO timeline (you indicated Jul 15 target).
2) If Jul 15 PO feasible, Ben will prepare the blended pricing amendment and Jordan will pre-seed DocuSign with the SLA addendum.
3) We schedule a 25-minute ops call (Ben + Jordan + Grace + Skylark infra) to confirm rollout windows and alerting — suggested Jul 9 or Jul 12, 10:00 PDT.

Ben/Jordan — can you confirm you can have the draft pricing amendment + DocuSign envelope ready by Jul 8?

Thanks,
Grace

Quick update — pricing amendment and DocuSign prep are in motion.
- Ben, I've aligned the blended reserved price and the burst uplift; amendment includes explicit hour-block billing for the burst pool to simplify invoicing.
- DocuSign envelope created: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature-request/abc123 (pre-populated fields for PO and signatures).
- I added a fallback clause to cap our overage exposure to the first 72 hours of any unmitigated surge. Legal has a look but it's minor language.

Priya — if July 15 PO target holds, I'll route the DocuSign and procurement ticket on Wednesday Jul 7 so legal can finish redlines ahead of signature.

Grace — happy to join the Jul 9 ops call; adding short slide on rollback automation.

—Jordan
